steps.name: Fetch the source-bound Python policy baseline
steps.run:
# The event supplies the comparison commit; this is source input, not a base-branch test run.
# tools/ci_python_policy.py
base="$(python3 -c 'import json,os; from tools.ci_python_policy import event_baseline; print(event_baseline(os.environ["GITHUB_EVENT_NAME"], json.load(open(os.environ["GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"], encoding="utf-8")), os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"]))')"
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$base"
printf 'LSF_PYTHON_POLICY_BASE=%s\n' "$base" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Validate reviewed CI contracts and observe the tested source
steps.run:
# Reviewed delegated parser/storage owners, not additional runners:
# tools/ci_contracts.py tools/ci_lane_inventory.py tools/workflow_action_yaml.py
python3 tools/ci_coverage.py --receipt target/ci/observed-inventory.json

LSF_REQUIRE_NATIVE_PROCESS_TESTS=1 python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_ci_profile tools.tests.test_validate_docs tools.tests.test_ci_suite_inventory tools.tests.test_ci_suite_discovery tools.tests.test_ci_result tools.tests.test_ci_coverage tools.tests.test_ci_contracts tools.tests.test_ci_browser_artifacts tools.tests.test_ci_lanes tools.tests.test_ci_lane_inventory tools.tests.test_local_tests tools.tests.test_ci_cargo tools.tests.test_ci_cargo_cache tools.tests.test_ci_cargo_aot_handoff tools.tests.test_ci_cargo_evaluate
